profile.subject: a slender grey tabby cat
profile.styleHints: Slender grey tabby with dark stripes, big upright ears, green eyes, long ringed tail

cycle.prompt: Horizontal sprite sheet of exactly 4 frames in 4 equal columns with wide magenta gaps, same slender grey tabby cat in strict side profile facing right, one green eye visible, same size every frame, walking gait cycle with legs alternating, long striped tail extended, large upright ears

profile.idlePrompt: Pose: Standing alert in side view facing right, body level, tail extended back, ears up, green eye looking forward

rest.label: Sit calmly
rest.prompt: Pose: Sitting upright with chest up, front paws together, long striped tail curled around paws, ears up

sleep.label: Curl up nap
sleep.prompt: Pose: Curled tightly on side with tail tucked over nose, eyes closed, ears relaxed, paws folded in

voice.label: Meow
voice.prompt: Pose: Sitting with head tilted up, mouth open mid-meow, tail upright, ears forward

trick.label: Wave paw
trick.prompt: Pose: Sitting up on haunches with one front paw raised high, head tilted, tail curled, playful look

lines: Hi I'm Mochi, let's explore together!
Did you see that? I was so fast!
I have big eyes for spying fun!
Catch me if you can, hee hee!
My tail is stripey, isn't it cool?
Stay with me, I love you lots!

facts.text: Tabbies have a cute M shape on their foreheads.
Tabby is a coat pattern, not a cat breed.
Tabbies can be orange, gray, brown, and more colors.
